biography_sections.title: Three Johns and the Gairbraid source conflict
biography_sections.markdown: Hill’s inspected printed p. 53 distinguishes senior John Hutcheson in Gairbraid, husband of Marion Wilson or Jarden, from their eldest son John, husband of Agnes Anderson. The existing John profile mixes those generations; the attached father relationship to Thomas remains uncertain without a percentage. In Hill’s title account the 19 November 1582 confirmation names the eldest son John as recipient, calls his father deceased and names Marion as the recipient’s mother. Hill identifies Thomas of Lambhill as the younger son and associates the eldest John and Agnes in the 2 October 1588 sasine. The eldest John or his son John, husband of Janet Johnstone, apparently conveyed the property or reversion to George on 5 August 1600. The grantor remains unresolved. [Inspected printed page 53](https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n78.jpg). Underlying charters uninspected. Visually checked [printed p. 87](https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n114.jpg) supports this generational distinction; it is from the same compiled book, and the underlying originals remain uninspected.
